text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Shoes, check. Outfit, check. Clover in my 
pocket... aaand check!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The fur on your ears and tail is glossier 
than usual, too. And next is...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
With your passionate cheers, maybe it'll 
be perfect...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you♪ Well then, in answer to your 
cheers... I shall certainly emerge 
victorious!
